messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout failed for model 'redwood-legacy-v2' in us-east-1. Automated checks found a signature mismatch between weight-bundle.tar.gz and tokenizer/metadata.json. Canary traffic being paused — initiating rollback to previous stable bundle. Details: https://ci.redwood/internal/deploys/4521

lia_oncall: Acknowledged. I'm oncall — pinging infra and ml. Any immediate customer impact?

maria_ops: We saw an increase in tokenization errors and some 500s from the canary hosts. Canary was ~7% traffic. Moving flag `use_weightbundle_v2` to OFF should stop routed traffic to the new bundle.

jonah: Copying logs: ``ERROR tokenization: checksum mismatch expected=0x9a3b got=0x1f2c at tokenizer/metadata.json``. Affected hosts are: canary-01..03. I’m running quick health checks now.

kevin_ml: Likely cause: packaging script omitted tokenizer shard (tokenizer/shard-0001.json) when creating weight-bundle.tar.gz. The bundle signature was generated from the incomplete tar. If we force-rollback the bundle that should restore sane behavior.

customer_success_anna: Heads up — SEs on three customers reported garbled completions and one customer (acme-inc) reported partial messages and reconnects. They've opened support tickets. CS has notified priority customers.

product_sam: Can we confirm rollback ETA and whether any persisted outputs were affected? Need wording for customers.

lia_oncall: Rolling back canary bundle now. Running deploy pipeline rollback step:
```
./deploy rollback --env=us-east-1 --service=redwood-inference --canary --from-version=stable-20260314
```
I'll also flip the flag:
```
./feature-flag set use_weightbundle_v2 false --env=prod --region=us-east-1
```

maria_ops: Also removing the canary hosts from LB pool to avoid stray traffic while rollback completes.

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued (job-id=rb-4521). Watch logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/rb-4521/logs

jonah: Quick mitigation note: you can hotpatch the tokenizer shard into the existing S3 bundle if we want a fast re-canary after fix: 
```
aws s3 cp tokenizer/shard-0001.json s3://artifacts.redwood/weights/redwood-legacy-v2/tokenizer/shard-0001.json --acl private
aws s3 cp weight-bundle.tar.gz s3://artifacts.redwood/weights/redwood-legacy-v2/weight-bundle.tar.gz --metadata checksum=0x9a3b --acl private
```
But prefer to rebuild to ensure packaging script is fixed.

kevin_ml: I'll push a patch to the packaging script (PR 674) to include tokenizer shards and add an integrity check. ETA ~45m.

lia_oncall: Rollback job completed: job-id=rb-4521 status=SUCCESS. Canary traffic drained and stable bundle restored. Flipped feature flag `use_weightbundle_v2` to false. LB pool back to stable hosts.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback confirmed. Canary hosts health=OK (after drain).

customer_success_anna: Noted — contacting affected customers with post-rollback update. No data loss reported; only malformed outputs during window.

product_sam: Thanks team. Assigning follow-ups: ML to fix packaging + add CI checksum, EngSRE to add deploy guard to prevent missing tokenizer files, CS to draft customer note.

incident_bot: Incident closed to on-call (SEV2). Please file a postmortem in #postmortems and link PRs (packaging fix + deploy guard) and timeline.

lia_oncall: Adding short timeline to thread:
- 1898765432 deploy-bot: canary failed (signature mismatch)
- lia_oncall: acknowledged, paused canary and flipped flag
- 1898765500 rollback started (rb-4521)
- 1898765590 rollback success, traffic restored to stable
- 1898765650 kevin_ml opened PR 674 for packaging fix

jonah: Saving logs and sample malformed outputs to the incident bucket: s3://incidents/1898765432/samples

maria_ops: Marking for postmortem and linking monitoring dashboards (tokenization-error-rate, canary-traffic)

product_sam: I'll draft the initial customer-facing blurb and share in #customer-commms for review.

lia_oncall: OK, handing back to normal ops. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
